svcdoctor · postgres · db.internal:<port>

  ✗ FAIL  DNS  <duration>  DNS_NO_ADDRESS

Findings
  ✗ ERROR  DNS_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED  db.internal:<port>
    The requested hostname did not resolve to a usable address from this vantage point
    The resolver answered, and the answer contained no address this client could use.
    This does not establish that the hostname is unknown: the same answer is returned for a name that has no address record, and many resolvers do not distinguish the two. It also says nothing about whether the service behind the name is running.
    Resolution depends on which resolver this host uses, so a different vantage point may resolve the same name.
    → Check that the hostname is spelled as intended and that it has an address record visible to the resolver this host is configured to use
    evidence: 1
